The linear momentum of the ball along common normal will not
change but remain same along common tangent during the collision.

The linear momentum of the ball along common normal will change
but remain same along common tangent during the collision.
solution:
Since impulse acts along common normal the linear momentum of the
ball along common normal will change. There is no impulse along common
tangent therefore linear momentum of the ballwill not change during the
collision.

$t = t_{1}$and $t = t_{2}$. $\left( t_{1} < t_{2} \right)$. Then the

solution:
$H = \frac{u^{2}}{2g}$;$\frac{3}{4}\left( \frac{u^{2}}{2g} \right) = ut - \frac{1}{2}gt^{2} \Rightarrow t = \frac{u}{g} \pm \frac{u}{2g}$
$\Rightarrow t_{1} = \frac{u}{2g}$and$t_{2} = \frac{3u}{2g} \Rightarrow t_{1}:t_{2} = 1:3$
